title: Anniversary cake every relative can eat: Stanhope Gardens, Kellyville Ridge
summary:
An anniversary cake for Stanhope Gardens or Kellyville Ridge that every relative at the table can eat, grandparents included.

Every cake at our Riverstone store is 100% eggless. Not the sponge, not the buttercream, not any of the 15 flavours. Which is why nobody at a 25th or 40th has to ask what's in it before the toast.

An 8-inch serves 12-14 from $49.99. A 10-inch serves 20-22 from $74.99. Send us a photo of your original wedding cake and we'll take the design from there.

Two days' notice: order Thursday, pick up Saturday. Free parking at Riverstone Shopping Centre. WhatsApp 0425 697 725 to order.

Forty years married. The cake only has to last the evening. 🎂
